title: HTTP State Management Mechanism
summary: This document specified HTTP cookies: the Cookie and Set-Cookie headers that let a server keep state across requests. It differed from Netscape's earlier cookie proposal but could interoperate with it. It is historic and was replaced by RFC 2965.

eli5.summary: A website hands you a numbered ticket on your first visit and asks to see it each time you come back.
